name: @joyofit/watch-navi
description: JoyoNavi, the HarmonyOS lite-wearable watch app (bundle com.joyodigitama.navi) that shows JoyoFit's turn-by-turn navigation on a Huawei Watch Fit 4 / 4 Pro. Built with hvigor (CLI) or DevEco Studio; this package only holds the image generator and the logic tests.
